waybackify remaster build [flags] <hermetic-root> <remastered-root>

Remaster a hermetic cache root into a standalone root

Remaster a hermetic cache root into a standalone remastered root —
chrome stripped, wayback references localized to /web/<ts><flag>/<orig>,
sidecars carried over, a content-addressed build record written at the
root. Deterministic: the same hermetic tree yields a byte-identical
remastered tree.

Output: a summary line on stdout (--json for the run record). The
remastered root drops straight under a waybackify-serve --root.

Arguments:
  <hermetic-root>     sealed cache root to read (contains cap/ meta/)
  <remastered-root>   output root to write (created; supply a fresh dir)

Flags:
  --json              emit the run summary as JSON
  --help|-h           Show help

part of the wayback.charlie.dev mirror tooling
